**Issue #3596 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3596: Patch: Stinkyscape+ fullsend 1: the mechanics, every card and the release, the AI dealing itself none of it
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

Fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (tracker #3533), v0.6.0. It builds the engine's new mechanics and every card, then ships the set, so players can play it against each other while the AI deals itself none of it (R1390's soft gate).

**This issue replaces #3534** (the owner, 2026-11-10): the foundation (#3535) and the engine chain (E1–E9) are no longer built in a Claude session. The night bot builds every part, the foundation included. #3534 was adopted as a tree while #3535 was labelled `human`, so #3535 was left out of its parts and would have landed on `main` while the parts built on `bot/issue-3534` without it. Its parts moved here, and this issue is adopted afresh with all 37, so every part lands on this issue's integration branch, `bot/issue-3596`, cut from `main`'s head.

The night bot builds it in its fullsend mode (`bot/README.md`, Fullsend). It is split by hand, so its sub-issues are its parts, and the bot adopts them (`queue.Adopt`). Each part lands on the integration branch as soon as it is built, once the parts its `Blocked by` line names have landed. When the last part closes, the reconcile builds this issue on that branch and opens one pull request into `main`.

The parts' bodies say "fullsend 1 (#3534)" and "Part of #3534": read both as this issue. Where a part's body says the plan and the list are "on `main` once the foundation (#3535) merges", read it as on the integration branch once the foundation lands there.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP8 is this tree's table, SP9 its order). The designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9`, and the foundation (#3535) brings them onto the integration branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). The owner's calls of 2026-11-09 are in the plan and in the parts they touch:

- Flexible: a Unit in the backrow attacks and acts as a normal Unit, and Flying Units innately have Flexible (E3).
- Bottom-of-deck cards lie in random order among themselves (E8).
- Reignclipse has Tribute 3 (S14).
- A card with no winrate counts as 50% (S17).
- Every random card is unique unless the pool runs out (E9).
- Call to Chaos summons or casts 5 Jlockeed cards (S24).

The shipped-card side of E3 (Evasive and Frenzy on shipped cards) and E5 (the Replenish rewording) is in S01 (#3551), and E9 lands behind `UNIQUE_RANDOM_DRAWS = false`, which R (#3573) turns on, as those parts' bodies say. Everything here reaches `main` together in the reconcile's one pull request.

## The parts (37)

**The foundation**
- [ ] #3535 F, the foundation

**The engine chain** (each waits for the one before it, so none is ever parked)

**The release**

## Order

Each part's `Blocked by` line holds its order:

1. #3535
2. #3536, #3537, #3538, #3539
3. #3540, #3541, #3542; then #3543, #3544, #3545; then #3546, #3547; then #3548, #3549; then #3550, #3551, #3552, #3553; then #3554, #3555, #3556, #3557; then #3558, #3559, #3560, #3561; then #3563
4. #3565, #3566, #3567, #3568, #3569
5. #3570, #3571
6. #3572
7. #3573
8. the reconcile

## Done when (the reconcile)

- [ ] Every part's cards play by their text and the plan's readings (SP3, SP5, SP6). The reconcile judges each part against its sub-issue and fixes a seam, a name, a missing case, a red test or a collision itself.
- [ ] Stinkyscape+ is in `SHIPPED_SETS` (its row `Shipped`) and in `AI_DECK_GATED_SETS`. Every new prompt and card is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] One pending fragment claims every new entry and every shipped card that plays differently (S01, E3's migration, E5's wording, S17's xxFreshJack, E9's rule), and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` passes.
- [ ] The server's migration admits the new tags and seeds the set. Deck and trio codes take it (R1410). The golden traces are re-blessed once, and the seed-pinned tests are re-pinned. The voice files are rendered (`[gen:voice]`). Every stated total moves.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `names --check`, `golden check`, `fuzz --seeds 200` and `gate` pass, as do `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e`.
- [ ] REVIEW.md's audit runs as a separate session (CLAUDE.md rule 8), and its findings are fixed or filed.
- [ ] The pull request into `main` merges with `rust`, `web`, `e2e smoke`, `db` and `bot selftest` green (CLAUDE.md rule 12). Within two hours `staging` carries it, and the tracker (#3533) records that, and production after it.

Part of #3533.
```
